definition: Net income attributable to the parent's shareholders: after the non-controlling (minority) interests' share, including discontinued operations.
note: Backlog #157: the textbook net margin's numerator (CFA Level I, Financial Analysis Techniques; IAS 1.81B 'attributable to owners of the parent'). Not ProfitLoss, which under US GAAP is consolidated net income including non-controlling interests. Reported figures only, never read by a valuation.

definition: Net income attributable to the parent's shareholders: after the non-controlling (minority) interests' share, including discontinued operations.
note: JUDGMENT: CAT 2012+ tags its 'profit attributable to common shareholders' only this way. After preferred dividends, so equal to net income to the parent for a company without preferred stock (none of the eight has any).

definition: Income (loss) from discontinued operations, net of tax, the parent's share.
note: Backlog #157: shown beside net margin so a one-off exit (JNJ 2023, Kenvue) is not read as a better business. Ranked first: the parent's share, on net income's basis (ASC 810-10-50-1A). Reported figures only.

definition: Income (loss) from discontinued operations, net of tax, the parent's share.
note: Total including any non-controlling share; used where a filing tags only this line (PG to 2019, WMT to 2017).

definition: Fair value of long-term debt at the balance date, as the filing's fair-value note estimates it (usually with the current portion; not short-term borrowings or commercial paper); never counted as debt.
note: Backlog #481 item 3: shown beside the book debt on the debt card of inputs_behind, never read by a valuation. Tagged by MSFT (2010+), KO (2010+) and PG (2015+); AAPL, JNJ and CAT give it only in text or by instrument. DebtInstrumentFairValue is not mapped: it is one instrument's figure (KO 2,639M at 2017-03-31 beside long-term debt near 30B), not the total.

definition: The weighted average effective interest rate on long-term debt at the balance date, as the filing's debt note states it (a fraction: 0.0319 = 3.19%); never read by a valuation.
note: Backlog #542: shown beside J&J's cost of debt, whose interest line is net of gains on its currency swaps since FY2019, as the rate J&J says it pays (debt note, "weighted average effective rate"). J&J files one undimensioned value per year end in every 10-K from FY2011 to FY2024 (FY2025's 10-K does not tag it). JNJ only: other companies tag this concept per instrument or with a dimension the company facts file drops, so a figure read for them would be one bond's rate, not the total; check a company's filings before widening the scope.
